Title: Azure Site Recovery: Support released for large disks (up to 8 TB)

Body.Content: You can now protect large data disks of up to 8 TB in size with Azure Site Recovery. This capability is available to all Azure VMs which are on managed disks and also available to all on-premises machines which are replicating to managed disks in Azure. The feature is deployed in all public geos and will be extended to national clouds this week. For more information, see the Azure Site Recovery support matrix.
